title: Show a delivery arriving
prompt: opening is how many tasks were open and arrivals is how many just came in. Both are supplied whole numbers. The starter prints the opening count, then an out-of-date total. Give total its new value between the two print lines. With 6 open and 2 arriving, the output is 6 then 8, one number per line.
hints: Read the print lines from top to bottom. Which one should see the new value?
An assignment works out its right side first, then stores the result in the name on the left.
Between the prints, add arrivals to the current total and store the result back in total.
checkLabels: The output must be the opening count, then the count after the arrivals, on two lines.
total must end as opening plus arrivals.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Replaces the total with the arrivals instead of adding them.
Updates the total after both lines have printed.

feedback: Check which print runs before your update and which runs after it. The first line must still show the opening count.
